name: Enclave of the Hourglass
summary: The Enclave of the Hourglass is a fort to the south of Kvatch. Historically, it was the headquarters of the Order of the Hour. After sitting vacant abandoned for a long time, they have recently moved back in as they bolster their forces in the region. A pamphlet can be found on the floor in front of the enclave's northwestern gate. Two Horses and a White Mane Horse are in the stables at the entrance. Centipdes, fleshflies and rats are found in numbers within.
notes: Although not physically present in Oblivion Remastered's version of the Gold Coast, this location is mentioned in the Deluxe Edition quest Saving Time Itself, where the lich Corelian steals an Elder Scroll from the Enclave's basement.
